title: STATION ZERO / THE LONG WAY HOME

sectors.name: 01 / DOCKING QUARTER
sectors.description: Arrivals and service piers. The station has gone silent.

sectors.name: 02 / TRANSIT WORKS
sectors.description: Restore the transit grid and reconnect the districts.

sectors.name: 03 / HYDROPONICS BAY
sectors.description: Food and oxygen decks. Something is still growing in the dark.

sectors.name: 04 / FOUNDRY DECK
sectors.description: Fabrication furnaces. A cutting rig can open any sealed door.

sectors.name: 05 / CARGO EXCHANGE
sectors.description: Recover the evacuation manifests among abandoned freight.

sectors.name: 06 / REACTOR SPINE
sectors.description: Coolant lines are failing. Shut down the reactor override.

sectors.name: 07 / MEDICAL WARD
sectors.description: Triage bays hold the supplies the survivors will need.

sectors.name: 08 / HABITAT RING
sectors.description: Habitation pods still hold survivors. Restore their uplink.

sectors.name: 09 / SALVAGE YARD
sectors.description: Crushed hull sections. Enough plating to patch the shuttle.

sectors.name: 10 / DATA ARCHIVE
sectors.description: Server stacks holding the crew register and its backups.

sectors.name: 11 / COMMS ARRAY
sectors.description: Deep-space dishes. Get one pointed at the rescue lane.

sectors.name: 12 / COMMAND REACH
sectors.description: The security commander controls the evacuation lock.

missions.title: A signal in the dark
missions.brief: Find the dock relay. Reconnect it to learn what happened to Station Zero.

missions.title: Bring the grid online
missions.brief: Reach Transit Works, secure its generator crew and restore station power.

missions.title: Water and air
missions.brief: The hydroponics bay has overgrown. Clear the tenders and purge the bloom.

missions.title: Forge a way through
missions.brief: Take the foundry cutting rig from its crew. Every sealed door opens after this.

missions.title: Names, not numbers
missions.brief: Search Cargo Exchange for all three evacuation manifests. The survivors need a route home.

missions.title: Stop the cascade
missions.brief: Defeat the coolant wardens at the Reactor Spine and disable the override.

missions.title: Triage
missions.brief: Strip the Medical Ward of its stores before the survivors reach the habitat.

missions.title: Open the lifeline
missions.brief: Clear the Habitat Ring watch and open its evacuation uplink.

missions.title: Patch the hull
missions.brief: Fight through the Salvage Yard crew and recover enough plating for the shuttle.

missions.title: Everyone on the register
missions.brief: Pull all three archive cores so no one is left off the evacuation register.

missions.title: Send the signal
missions.brief: Clear the Comms Array guard and power a dish toward the rescue lane.

missions.title: Break the lockdown
missions.brief: Find the security commander in Command Reach. Take back control of the evacuation lock.

missions.title: The long way home
missions.brief: Return through the connected station to the Docking Quarter and board the evacuation shuttle.
